messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike on /v1/generate (us-west-2). p99=3.1s (SLO=1.5s), p95=1.0s. streaming stalls rising. auto-page @alyssa.oncall
alyssa.oncall: picking this up. any customer reports? is this region-local?
cj.sre: metrics look concentrated to us-west-2. spike onset ~16:12 UTC. overall qps steady but tail and retry rate up on a subset of backends.
mike-runtime: router logs show elevated retry loops and backend queueing. suspect misrouting or weight skewing.
router-team: we pushed zone-aware-weighted policy (canary) at 15:50 UTC to reduce cross AZ egress; rolling to ~12% nodes in the region. correlates with timeframe.
tara-support: three tickets opened — customers report token gaps and streaming pauses, not hard 5xx. partial responses seen.
kevin-pm: P1. propose immediate mitigation if simple. what are quick options?
julia-devex: can ops surface the top routing keys and backend queue depths?
cj.sre: running aggregation: top keys window 16:00-16:18 UTC -> user_token_42 ~ 38%, session_hash_7 ~ 14%, user_token_99 ~ 9%. heavy skew.

cj.sre: datadog query used:
```
avg(last_5m):top(avg:router.request.count{region:us-west-2} by {routing_key}, 10)
```

mike-runtime: tracing a few paths: route_select(zone-aware-weighted) -> backend be-092 queue=145 -> wait 2400ms -> backend timeout -> retry -> other backend -> 300ms. that queuing explains streaming stalls.
router-team: digging into the policy code: when nodes are cordoned/evicted, the normalization step erroneously treats their weight as zero but doesn't normalize the remaining weight properly, resulting in weight concentration on small set of active hosts.
alyssa.oncall: can we short-circuit by applying a region-scoped override to soft-balanced to spread traffic evenly?
ops_lead: this will increase inter-AZ egress briefly. check egress budget before flipping.
cj.sre: egress budget checked; small spike for ~10m stays under contract. recommend override for 15m and monitor.

mike-runtime: applying override now: 
```
# temporary override to soft-balanced for us-west-2 /v1/generate
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/overrides -d '{"region":"us-west-2","route":"/v1/generate","policy":"soft-balanced","ttl":900}'
```

mike-runtime: override accepted, propagating. will also mark hottest backends for draining and add ephemeral nodes +15% capacity for 20m.
router-team: confirmed routers picked up override within 20s windows. queue depths for be-092/be-107 dropping.
alyssa.oncall: p99 trending down 3.1 -> 1.7s after override.
tara-support: two customers confirm improvement; one large customer (ACME-Corp) still reports sporadic streaming gaps on an existing session.
kevin-pm: ACME on outreach list. ensure a concise incident note for CSMs.

mike-runtime: KV cache metrics show a miss spike for the top keys during the skew period; thrash caused CPU pressure on eviction path. warming caches should help as traffic evens.
sara-eng: we observed that sticky session hinting + the new policy caused some shard stickiness; combined with evicted nodes that led to placement hotness.
julia-devex: request: add routing-policy and backend-weight headers to traces to make future triage faster. can we do that as a quick instrumentation bump?
router-team: yes, we can add headers in the next deploy; moving to high priority. ETA 48h for rollout.

ops_lead: mitigation checklist status? are we risking other regions with the override?
cj.sre: cross-region ripple minimal; monitoring shows no abnormal egress in eu-west. safe to keep override for 15m + watch.
mike-runtime: added +15% ephemeral nodes and triggered drains on be-092/be-107. drain completed for be-092 at 16:30 UTC, queue_depth stabilized.
alyssa.oncall: bridge created for coordination: https://inc.bridge/8833400011 — joining. owners: router-team (policy + patch), runtime (override + scaling), sres (metrics), support (customer comms).

router-team: pause applied to canary controller at 16:34 UTC to stop further adoption of zone-aware-weighted. opening a PR for normalization fix. ETA for patch (MVP) ~2.5h.
kevin-pm: good. keep override until patch merged + 30m soak.

cj.sre: post-mitigation snapshot 16:45 UTC: p99=0.96s, p95=0.84s, streaming-stall counts back to baseline. error rates normal.
tara-support: updating tickets to mitigated; ACME-Corp confirmed improvement after backend drains and override but logs show one session gap at ~16:18 UTC (in-flight). offering follow-up support.

alyssa.oncall: draft root cause: zone-aware-weighted canary + normalization bug when nodes cordoned -> weight concentration on active hosts -> hot partitions -> queue backpressure and KV-cache thrash -> streaming stalls -> SLO breach.
router-team: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/router/normalize-cordoned-fix (WIP). will include unit test for cordoned node scenario.
mike-runtime: keeping override active and ephemeral capacity for another 30m, then will unwind if stable.

julia-devex: will add the override curl snippet, the datadog top-key query, and a short playbook to the runbook (ETA 8h).
ops_lead: action items (owners + ETAs):
- router-team: patch normalization bug (MVP) - ETA 2.5h (PR opened)
- router-team: add routing metadata to traces - ETA 48h
- runtime: add queue_depth > 100 alert + p99 surge alert - ETA 24h
- devex: runbook patch with example commands - ETA 8h
- support: customer outreach template & account notes - ETA 4h

alyssa.oncall: incident ticket INC-2026-0711 opened. plan postmortem + customer impact review tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. p99 restored to 0.96s. bridge will close in 30m if stable.

tara-support: please log outreach to ACME-Corp and include potential credit offer language.
kevin-pm: thanks all. good containment and fast mitigation. ensure timeline + dashboards included in postmortem.
router-team: concise RCA line for the postmortem: canary routing policy + normalization edge-case (cordoned nodes) => weight skew => hot partitions => tail latency spike.
alyssa.oncall: archiving thread. follow-ups tracked in INC-2026-0711. :white_check_mark:
